the English language is a dynamic and changing system of communication that is used in a variety of ways by different people in different contexts.
the students in our study were intelligent and accomplished users in their own languages, and they used this intelligence in creative and effective ways in the learning of the English language.

what teachers need to understand about the language and cultural realities of their students if they are to encourage their students to bring their own experience to the learning of English in the classroom.
the relationship between English, language and culture.
how teachers can encourage the creative and intelligent use of language by learners, especially in the context of a multilingual and multicultural environment.
